description: Create placemarks 'Sinuosity_Start' (33.4000°N, 91.0500°W) and 'Sinuosity_End' (33.2500°N, 91.2000°W) on the Mississippi River. Measure straight-line and actual channel distances between them. Create 'Sinuosity_Analysis' placemark at the midpoint with description recording: straight-line distance (km), channel length (km), sinuosity index (channel/straight, 2 decimals), and classification ('Straight' <1.3, 'Sinuous' 1.3-1.5, 'Meandering' >1.5). Save in folder 'Mississippi_Sinuosity' to ~/Documents/mississippi_sinuosity.kml.
